conventions.image_size_scaling: intrinsic.txt matches RGB size; no scaling applied.
conventions.occlusion_source: GT point-cloud z-buffer over the fixed deterministic surface sample; no RGB-D depth maps were found in posed_images/scene0000_00.
conventions.pose_convention: ScanNet 4x4 camera-to-world; translation is camera center in world coordinates.
conventions.projection_convention: OpenCV pinhole camera coordinates; +Z is in front; u=fx*x/z+cx, v=fy*y/z+cy; pixel bounds are half-open [0,width)x[0,height).
